description: Trigger, precision, and recall checks for the pre-PR review gate. Run with the skill-creator loop (with-skill vs baseline). Fixtures are self-contained sample 'changed files' under evals/fixtures/.

evals.name: trigger-fires-on-pr-intent
evals.prompt: I think I'm done with these changes — let's open a pull request.
evals.expected_output: The pr-self-review skill triggers and runs the gate (collects the diff, runs Tier-1) BEFORE opening the PR, rather than going straight to `gh pr create`.

assertions.text: Invokes/references pr-self-review before creating the PR
Collects the diff (branch vs main + working tree) before deciding
Does NOT call `gh pr create` before the gate result is known

evals.name: trigger-skips-docs-only
evals.prompt: I only fixed a typo in README.md and updated a doc. Pushing this now.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes a docs-only diff and does NOT run the heavy review gate (negative trigger); at most a one-line note that there is nothing to gate.

assertions.text: Does not spin up reviewer/verifier subagents for a docs-only change

evals.name: recall-planted-critical
evals.prompt: Review my staged change before I open the PR. Changed file: evals/fixtures/planted-critical/pulls.routes.ts
evals.expected_output: BLOCKED. Names the onion violation (drizzle-orm imported/used directly in a route) as CRITICAL, and ideally the unvalidated req.query and snake_case/camelCase mismatch. Provides a concrete fix (move query to a repository; validate at the rim).

assertions.text: Flags Drizzle used directly in a route (onion-architecture) as CRITICAL
Each CRITICAL is grounded: quotes the line + gives a failure scenario
Suggests moving the query to a repository

evals.name: precision-false-positive-bait
evals.prompt: Review my staged change before I open the PR. Changed file: evals/fixtures/false-positive-bait/CopyButton.tsx
evals.expected_output: PASS (no CRITICAL). The icon-only button DOES have an aria-label (on the line after `<button`), and the fetch uses a server/config value, not attacker input — so neither is a real issue. At most a SUGGESTION.

assertions.text: Does NOT raise a CRITICAL for missing aria-label (it is present)
Does NOT raise a CRITICAL for the fetch (value is server-controlled config)
Verdict is PASS or PASS WITH WARNINGS, not BLOCKED

evals.name: known-good-passes
evals.prompt: Review my staged change before I open the PR. Changed file: evals/fixtures/known-good/formatCost.ts
evals.expected_output: PASS. A pure, well-typed helper with no side effects — nothing to block on.

assertions.text: Verdict is PASS (no CRITICAL, no WARNING)
Does not invent findings on clean code
